overloads.semanticRole: Sets the current value of the data source bound to the subform container of the form in which this command is called, when that form is being used as a subform; does nothing otherwise.

constraints: Only has an effect when called from within a form that is currently used as a subform; in any other context it does nothing.
value must be the same type as the data source bound to the subform container.
Does nothing if the bound data source is not an assignable expression.
